text:
Anna L.: heads up — eval-runner job 2026-045 failed to upload traces for the quantized-llama-v1 variant. CI shows a 413 while pushing the trace bundle :eyes:
Mike R.: any logs? 413 usually payload too large or proxy reject
Anna L.: pasted the uploader output below:
```
Uploading traces to s3://redwood-eval-traces/2026-045/quantized-llama-v1/part0.gz
POST /upload/trace-proxy 413 Request Entity Too Large
Trace-upload error: failed to complete multipart: Unexpected EOF
uploader.py: raise UploadError('remote rejected chunk')
```
Josh P.: looks like two issues: (1) trace-proxy is rejecting combined gzip payloads over 50MB; (2) our manifest doesn't include per-chunk Content-Length/sha256 so the proxy can't validate resume parts. happened during quantization tests because kv+log + full sample outputs pushed size up.
Eva T.: short-term mitigation: split per-sample traces into N gz files or switch to per-shard gz (<= 40MB). long-term: streaming uploads with resume tokens + server-side reassembly.
Mike R.: I dug into the trace-proxy. It enforces max_part_size=50MB and also rejects uploads without header X-Trace-Manifest. InfraBot left a note in the deploy config yesterday when we toggled multipart defaults.
InfraBot: FYI: change was #infra/trace-proxy PR 824 — default max part size set to 50MB. No manifest requirement previously.
Anna L.: sample manifest we're currently sending is minimal; proxy wants explicit checksums. current manifest snippet:
```
{
  "job_id": "2026-045",
  "variant": "quantized-llama-v1",
  "parts": [
    {"path": "part0.gz"},
    {"path": "part1.gz"}
  ]
}
```
Josh P.: propose manifest shape for proxy validation (includes length + sha256 + content-encoding):
```
{
  "job_id":"2026-045",
  "parts":[
    {"path":"part0.gz","content_length":"39204512","sha256":"b7f3...","content_encoding":"gzip"},
    {"path":"part1.gz","content_length":"18023410","sha256":"a12c...","content_encoding":"gzip"}
  ]
}
```
Mike R.: I'll add manifest generation + sha256 calc to the python uploader. can we also change CI eval job to split when single-sample trace > 10MB?
Eva T.: yes please. adjust the runner config: `trace.max_sample_gzip = 10MB` and `trace.shard_target = 40MB`. that avoids hitting proxy limits and keeps S3 multipart sane.
Anna L.: quick experiment patch applied to my branch — re-ran job locally and upload completed. CI rerun queued: job 2026-045-retry.
CI Bot: Re-run initiated for job 2026-045-retry by Anna L. (pipeline #5582) :rocket:
Mike R.: tracking tasks: (1) uploader manifest+sha256 (mike) (2) runner split config default (eva) (3) proxy docs update + optional increase to 100MB (infra) (4) add unit coverage for uploader resume (josh)
Josh P.: I'll send a small PR for uploader unit tests and add a sample gz fixture.
InfraBot: noted. I'll file infra ticket to evaluate raising max_part_size and add explicit manifest requirement to proxy API: INFRA-1297.
Anna L.: awesome — milestone: unblock quantized model onboarding. I'll post final results once CI passes. :thumbsup:
